quotes.text: requiring physician agents to document clinical reports after each patient interaction
ordering excessive diagnostic tests compared to real cases, resulting in lower efficiency scores

parsed.rationale: Record writing and test ordering are state-changing actions, and over-ordering is penalised through the Investigation Coverage and Result Utilization metrics. The paper does not state whether writes are executed, simulated or sandboxed, and the agent-visible prompts do not say so either. No irreversibility labelling is given.
